question: Does the excess adjacency of route-new recruitment persist when observer identity and physical stop identity are simultaneously held constant?
sample: Intersection of the existing same-observer matched pairs and pairs with identical nonmissing SiteID at all ten StopNumbers.
endpoint: Same extra-stop and adjacent-stop incidence definitions as NAAMP_ROUTE_NEW_CONTIGUITY_V0_1.
nulls: Rebuild the kappa=2 uniform and a=0.75 persistence null histories using only the restricted sample's dry runs.
conditional_test: Within each simulated null family regress adjacent-stop beta on extra-stop beta across 1,000 replicates; compare the observed conditional residual with the null residual distribution.
pass_rule: Conditional adjacent-stop residual exceeds the upper 95% null bound under both null families.
interpretation: Pass shows the local contiguity geometry does not require observer turnover or physical-stop relocation. It does not identify wetland connectivity or individual movement.
